bureau: Credit reporting agencies licensed by the Bank of Zambia
note: The Credit Reporting Act, 2018 (Act 8 of 2018, published 31 July 2018, commenced 17 October 2019 by the Commencement Order, 2019), in ZambiaLII's source PDF read from archive.org's snapshot of 5 November 2025 (zambialii.org itself answers with a Cloudflare check; ZambiaLII's page, in a snapshot of 14 May 2026, lists no amending act, only the commencement). Section 29(e): a credit reporting agency shall not include in a credit report information on a debt three years after the debt's final payment or, if no payment is made, five years after the person incurred it. The game reads this as a late payment shown five years while unpaid (keep 5; the Act counts from when the debt was incurred, the game from the late payment) and lifting three years after it is paid, written as 1096 days (three years of 365.25 days). No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the next monthly update.
